precepts.text: Of making many books there is no end, and much study is a weariness of the flesh. Any book you try to live by outside the Bible profits you nothing but tiredness, unless a demon flies out of it. Books are brought in class only filtered through the Bible, to give the sense as in Nehemiah 8:8; if a book contradicts it, it is garbage. The conclusion of the whole matter: fear God and keep his commandments, found only in the Bible, for this is the whole duty of man. The image of God is doing what God said.
precepts.point: They shall possess it for ever, from generation to generation. Through every captivity the Most High made sure the Bible followed us; the Greeks tried to destroy it and he raised Ezra to bring it back. The Bible did not go anywhere; your mind went into dysfunction and left it.

note.label: The Image of Dysfunction or the Image of God Which One Are You?

precepts.why:
“Seek ye out of the book of the Lord, and read”. The book of the Lord is no other book on this planet except the Bible. Solomon warns: “And further, by these, my son, be admonished: of making many books there is no end; and much study is a weariness of the flesh.”

Anything outside of the Bible that you try to live your life by is a weariness of the flesh. All you will profit from it is getting tired. You might get a good night's sleep, unless a demon flies out of the bag reading some book with some kind of skin on it. There is no end to these books: they are always writing some book about what God is going to do on this earth, about his plans and who his people are. No other book can answer that except the Bible. The much study of the rest of these books is a waste of time.

When books are brought in class, they are filtered through the Bible. If they contradict the Bible, if they go against the laws, the commandments and the prophecies, they are garbage. They are brought only to illuminate the reading, as in Nehemiah 8:8.

“Let us hear the conclusion of the whole matter”: the conclusion of the whole matter is in the Bible. Daniel says the same: “Hitherto is the end of the matter”, the kingdom given to the people of the saints of the Most High. “Fear God, and keep his commandments”: his commandments are found in the book of the Lord, not in the Quran, not in the Egyptian book of the dead. That is how you know which is the book of the Lord.

“for this is the whole duty of man.” The image of God is doing what God said. The man spoken of is the Israelite man, because we are the ones who will make everybody else dance to the tune of this Bible, but it has to be done by us first. We are in training. That is why we are on this slave ship called America: because we broke God's laws and his commandments, and we must endure all of it to get back home.

precepts.text: You have one job on this earth: fear God and keep his commandments. You have been given a brain to understand how to fear God, what the commandments of God are, and how to apply the laws of God in your life. That is why you got a mind. If you are using your mind for anything else, filling it up with video game moves and the stats of every player, you are on that broad road to destruction. Fill your mind with thus saith the Lord: how do I deal with my wife, how do I deal with my kids, what can I do to become stronger so the Lord can use me?
precepts.point: Wherefore I give you to understand, that no man speaking by the Spirit of God calleth Jesus accursed: and that no man can say that Jesus is the Lord, but by the Holy Ghost. By him actions are weighed. Somebody speaking of Christ and calling him accursed, that is not of the Lord; somebody who confessed Christ is Lord, this person believes.

note.label: Members of the Body  Pt2

precepts.why:
You have one job on this earth, and you have been given a mind to do that job. Solomon gives it: “Let us hear the conclusion of the whole matter: Fear God, and keep his commandments: for this is the whole duty of man.” One duty.

You have a brain to understand how to fear God. You have a brain to understand what the commandments of God are. You have a brain to apply the laws of God in your life. That is why you have a mind. Congratulations: you know the meaning of life now.

If you are doing anything else with your mind, you missed. You are on that broad road to destruction. You cannot fill your mind with kill moves on Mortal Kombat, the moves on the PlayStation, the stats of Kobe and whether the NBA finals are over. We don't give a damn about none of that. Fill your mind with thus saith the Lord. Apply it to what is necessary in life: How do I deal with my wife? How do I deal with my kids? What can I do to become stronger, a better asset in this truth, so the Lord can use me? That is what we are supposed to be concerned with. If you are concerned with something else, maybe this ain't you.

precepts.text: Let us hear the conclusion of the whole matter: Fear God, and keep his commandments: for this is the whole duty of man. There is no excuse for not observing a commandment.
precepts.point: Sisters, if you only knew: a righteous man will do almost anything to see you happy. The teaching from the teacher's own daughter: she comes running to the door, keeps her demeanor sweet, and can get anything from him; she knows her role and plays it well. If you want, you have to be a princess. Reverence him, make him feel like he is everything he is supposed to be, and watch what happens. All sisters were taught to use the physical to get what they want; a righteous man needs your spirit to be right, and then you will see that Ephesians 5 man you desperately want.

note.label: Respect: The Evidence Of Her Faith

precepts.why:
“let every one of you in particular so love his wife even as himself; and the wife see that she reverence her husband.” There is no room for options there. Nowhere does the scripture say you can respect him as long as he does this or that. If that's in your mind, you're led by the damn devil. Nobody says, I won't eat pork unless; I'll keep the Sabbath day if. No.

Your whole duty in life: “Let us hear the conclusion of the whole matter: Fear God, and keep his commandments: for this is the whole duty of man.” There is no excuse for not observing a commandment.

Now, if you are being beaten in a relationship, are we telling you to stay, sister? No. If he's beating you to a pulp, get away from him. Don't die, sister. He obviously isn't keeping the commandments if he's harming you. But if he is not asking you to sin, you do not have a reason. You show him through your chaste conversation and your actions that you are going to serve the Lord no matter what; you heap hot coals on his head.

Disrespect should never be an option. Only Satan gives you that option. If submission depends on his behavior, it isn't submission; it's manipulation. God told you to submit without a caveat, because it is a commandment, and keeping the commandments is the whole duty.

precepts.text: The dust shall return to the earth as it was, and the spirit shall return unto God who gave it.
precepts.point: Pride is hateful before God and man. You can repent and hop back to the right side, but on the side of pride you are on the side God hates, and everything he hates has an expiration date.

note.label: The Pride Of Thine Heart

precepts.why:
Solomon mentions that spirit again: “Then shall the dust return to the earth as it was: and the spirit shall return unto God who gave it.”

The body goes back to the dust it came from, and the spirit goes back to God who made it. All of this, the dust and the spirit, belongs to the Most High God. That is why pride is not made for us.

Sirach asks, “Why is earth and ashes proud?” and says that when a man is dead “he shall inherit creeping things, beasts, and worms.” The man who is today a king tomorrow shall die. Neither the body nor the spirit is ours to boast in: one returns to the earth, the other to its Maker. So the beginning of pride, departing from God and turning the heart away from the Maker, is turning away from the very one the spirit must return to.

precepts.text: The preacher was wise and set in order many proverbs.
precepts.point: Set thine house in order and reprove thy people. Order your own life first, then you can reprove others.

note.label: Pattern

precepts.why:
“Now therefore set thine house in order, and reprove thy people”. Your body is a house; that is the house you live in. Set your life in order, brother, with God's laws, statutes and commandments, and then you can reprove and teach your people. And the Most High has set men over us to do that very work.

“And moreover, because the preacher was wise, he still taught the people knowledge; yea, he gave good heed, and sought out, and set in order many proverbs.” Our leadership is wise, brothers and sisters; the Lord set them over us for a reason. They teach the people knowledge: how to overcome, how to lead ourselves in the way of righteousness.

Set in order many proverbs: that is what we do when we go over precepts. There are a lot of proverbs we read and don't understand, and leadership puts the puzzle together and sets them in order so you can understand the things of old. “The preacher sought to find out acceptable words: and that which was written was upright”. They search out what the people need and what they are going through. Sometimes they step on toes, just to wake you up or break the chain you have been fighting with.

So God did not leave us without help. When we go off, he set up brothers and sisters to guide us back home. You can never say God did not send help; the one who ignores it is caught up in stupidity.

precepts.text: Creation waits for the sons of God to be revealed and rule the earth rightly.
precepts.point: God brings every work into judgment with every secret thing, good or evil.

note.label: Transforming from Immorality into Beautiful Civility Part 2

precepts.why:
“Fear God, and keep his commandments: for this is the whole duty of man.” Man was put on this earth to rule it with God's commandments, and because we are not doing that, the earth is suffering; we are not in power. The earth was made to receive your direction, men.

Paul shows it: “For the earnest expectation of the creature waiteth for the manifestation of the sons of God.” Expectation means I am expecting something, and earnestly means with a begging type of attitude. The creation is earnestly waiting for the manifestation, and manifestation means the growth: time for us to stop being kids and manifest into men, to get ourselves together. The earth is waiting for the sons of God to manifest into gods, that is, to rule this planet properly.

And righteous women are waiting for that too. The woman is called woman because she is of man, and she is like the earth: you plant your seed in her and she brings forth fruit, but she needs your guidance. She is supposed to revolve around you, and when you are not in rulership she is out of orbit, like a satellite floating in space with no direction. That is why women cry, where are our black men? The father figure in the house got destroyed.

All of it fell apart when we broke the laws of the Most High from the very beginning, when the woman was out of order with her husband. So it is up to us men to fulfil the duty of manhood to fix it: to marry, build a nation, and rule rightly. That is what the whole creation is waiting on.

precepts.text: Every secret thing is brought into judgment.
precepts.point: God brings every work into judgment with every secret thing, good or evil.

note.label: Transforming from Immorality into Beautiful Civility Part 2

precepts.why:
Verse 13 gives the whole duty of man; verse 14 gives the reason: “For God shall bring every work into judgment, with every secret thing, whether it be good, or whether it be evil.” For means because. Keep his commandments, because this is the whole reason God put man on the earth, and because God shall bring every work into judgment.

So if we are not dealing with our marriages properly, there is going to be a judgment for that, and we are looking at it. People try to figure out the problem in the black community: the marriages are messed up. Whoring, adultery, fornication. A little leaven will destroy the whole congregation, and it has to be rooted out like a cancer.

“with every secret thing”: the nasty stuff people do behind closed doors, thinking nobody sees. In nearly 35 years in this truth, we have seen the Most High bring out what people thought they could hide, and he brings it out at the worst time for you. Like applying for a job years later, thinking you got away with it, and they pull records you didn't know existed: get out of my office. That's how the Lord is.

So keep your slate clean. Be a disciplined man: you may not always be motivated, but you must always be disciplined. When sin comes before you, it stops right there. Because every work, good or evil, is going to come out, we have to be men of holiness, integrity, righteousness, dignity, honor and valor. That is the whole duty of man.

precepts.text: Curse not the king in thy thought, for a bird of the air shall carry the voice.
precepts.point: God brings every work into judgment with every secret thing, good or evil.

note.label: Transforming from Immorality into Beautiful Civility Part 2

precepts.why:
God shall bring every secret thing into judgment, and the Lord even calls a bird to bring it out: “Curse not the king, no not in thy thought; and curse not the rich in thy bedchamber: for a bird of the air shall carry the voice, and that which hath wings shall tell the matter.” We have sat in judgments where they asked, how did he find out? It's that damn bird. Somebody might think it's a literal bird flying around; I took every precaution. But the Most High is going to bring it out anyway. That's why it says every secret thing.

No, not in thy thought. Some people speak against the council and the leadership, or have evil thoughts against the leaders, and think they will get away with it. The Most High put leadership to watch over you, and that is not an easy job. Leaders must give an account, good or bad. The goal is to give a good account: the brother came in one way and now he is a man of valor, married, moving in the right direction; the sister listened to counsel and got herself together. When they will not take counsel, the leader still has to give an account, with grief.

This is how we should have grown up. We grew up in a lawless society; in slavery the fathers were stripped from the homes and the men forced to give their seed but not allowed to raise it. The matter will be told on you in your evil, so fear God, keep his commandments, and honor the ones set over you.

precepts.text: Of making many books there is no end, and much study of books he did not command is a weariness of the flesh.
precepts.point: Do not go seeking books he did not command us to read: the book of Jasher, the book of the wars, the made-up book of Enoch are unnecessary matters. There are enough deep mysteries in the eighty books he gave us, the sixty-six and the books of the Apocrypha, to stay focused on.

note.label: Joshua 10: The Day the Sun Stood Still

precepts.why:
“And further, by these, my son, be admonished: of making many books there is no end; and much study is a weariness of the flesh.” Of making many books there is no end, and much study of books he did not command is a weariness of the flesh.

Do not go seeking books he did not command us to read: the book of Jasher, the book of the wars, the made-up book of Enoch. There are enough deep mysteries in the eighty books he gave us, the sixty-six and the books of the Apocrypha, to stay focused on.

precepts.text: By these, my son, be admonished; of making many books there is no end; you do not need to search out a lot of books thinking wisdom is missing, these books right here are what you need.
precepts.point: More to be desired are they than gold, yea than much fine gold, sweeter also than honey and the honeycomb; moreover by them is thy servant warned.

note.label: Psalm 19: The Perfect Law That Converts the Soul

precepts.why:
The judgments of the Lord are “More to be desired are they than gold, yea, than much fine gold”. Solomon says: “And further, by these, my son, be admonished: of making many books there is no end; and much study is a weariness of the flesh.”

By these be admonished. You do not need to search out a lot of books thinking wisdom is missing; of making many books there is no end. These books right here are what you need, more to be desired than fine gold and sweeter than honey.

precepts.text: Fear God and keep His commandments, for this is the whole duty of man; for God shall bring every work into judgment, with every secret thing, whether good or evil.
precepts.point: Nothing is hid from God. Whether it be good or evil, He brings every secret thing into judgment.

note.label: Psalm 69: Save Me, O God

precepts.why:
“O God, thou knowest my foolishness; and my sins are not hid from thee.” Nothing is hid from God. “Let us hear the conclusion of the whole matter: Fear God, and keep his commandments: for this is the whole duty of man. For God shall bring every work into judgment, with every secret thing, whether it be good, or whether it be evil.”

Whether it be good or evil, he brings every secret thing into judgment. That is why David does not try to hide his foolishness; his sins are not hid from the Most High, and the whole duty of man is to fear God and keep his commandments.

precepts.text: Fear the Most High and keep His commandments, for this is the whole duty of man, our whole purpose upon this earth.
precepts.point: I will walk at liberty, for I seek Thy precepts. I will speak of Thy testimonies also before kings and will not be ashamed, because we have the wisdom of this Bible, not the wisdom of this world.

note.label: Psalm 119: Blessed Are the Undefiled in the Way

precepts.why:
“So shall I keep thy law continually for ever and ever.” Solomon gives the conclusion: “Let us hear the conclusion of the whole matter: Fear God, and keep his commandments: for this is the whole duty of man.”

Our whole duty while we are on this earth is to keep the laws of the Most High. It is our whole purpose upon this earth, continually, for ever and ever.

note.label: The Beauty in Civility the Cost of Immorality

precepts.why:
“Remember them which have the rule over you”. That's the goads again. Remember them, respect them, pray for them. This is hard work, praying for mercy for all of us, including ourselves, and making sure we administer proper judgment. “who have spoken unto you the word of God”. Those are the wise words that prick you. “whose faith follow”. The faith we believe in is with us, and we're with that faith.

“considering the end of their conversation.” Listen for godly discourse, how to keep your lives right. That's the conversation we want the sisters having. The bishops put pressure on their wives to make sure the sisters are being taught righteousness and direction. Sometimes a sister does something nobody knew she would do, just as brothers sometimes do something out of the blue. That happens, but we still have to make sure the conversations are godly. The pressure is to do what God said, for their benefit.

Yes, we're strict, damn it. Think where these girls, seventeen, eighteen, nineteen, twenty, would be without it: diseases, babies, no husband, through by twenty-six, finished by twenty-nine, looking like a sea hag by thirty-five. We've got to fight to bring them up right. That's why God put them under the man, and they don't need weak-ass men. Be men and understand your purpose to rule this earth. The women get the benefit of that rulership when they get in order.

note.label: The Beauty in Civility the Cost of Immorality

precepts.why:
“Obey them that have the rule over you, and submit yourselves”. They're giving you the goads, the scriptures that prick you into righteousness. Appreciate it. Think about the near misses: Slick Willie could have got between your legs, knocked you up, walked away, and made you hoe number seventeen, another notch on his belt. You've escaped that. Whatever your past was, you're a new creature here. Get yourself together now.

That's why we work hard to set up Daughters of Sarah, Ladies in Waiting, Titus 2, all these programs. We're making proper sisters, daughters, wives, and mothers, that necessary part of building this nation. We aren't getting there without you. You're vital. If we're this serious about you, be serious about yourselves.

“for they watch for your souls, as they that must give account”. That's the heaviness on the leaders, the shepherds with these goads. When something goes wrong, we ask whether we went off or failed to handle something properly. We make a diligent inquiry right down to why you first thought of doing it, who was in the room, what time of day it was. Get to the root. Track the behavioral traits so when the next brother or sister begins that way, we can intercept before they destroy themselves. Without the cause, you won't solve the problem.

“that they may do it with joy, and not with grief”. We must give an account for every one of you, whether in righteousness or wickedness. We want to say you came with problems, learned the scriptures, went through the programs, got married, got children and a job and career, and got your family together. Trials still come, but we can give a good account of how the commandments cleaned you up. We don't want to say you didn't study, couldn't stop watching porn, smoking crack, or alcoholism, didn't listen, and aren't here anymore. That's grief.

“for that is unprofitable for you.” You suffer if we have to give that account with grief. You didn't adhere to the pricks. We have to let you go, cut off that hand or arm, and give the account that you didn't want to repent. We have to go through this to get to civility. Immorality costs us generations, our minds, the kingdom. Leadership is aging; we have to raise the next generation of brothers and sisters to carry this work on.

Bishop Kenaia's class last week was on point: radicalize the youth. Radicalize them to be hot in this truth. Christ said, I'd rather you cold or hot. Revelation 3:15. You've got to be hot in this truth, not letting BS pass. Make your fathers, grandfathers, and elders proud. We were entrusted with this gospel and won't let it turn into lasciviousness. As I would say now, we would spiritually break your neck. But I really wish that we could do it physically. That's what I'm really trying to say without saying it. Because I really want you to be that damn afraid to bring foolishness toward the prophets of God. With this Bible you know the past and the future and can travel through all ages. God gave that to Jacob. I ain't letting some worm mess it up. The hell with you and your mama.

Radius: a straight line from the center to the circumference of a circle or sphere. That circumference is how far the center point extends, not beyond. Radical is going beyond that circle in your thinking. When white people call you radical, you're thinking beyond the mold they set for you. It's a dog on a leash that can only go around inside that distance. Break the chain and run beyond their control, and you're radical. Don't beg Mr. white man to put the leash back on.

Look at the despair, our sons hating themselves and killing their own brothers and sisters, knocking women up without fatherhood and telling them to get abortions. Christianity is the leash keeping black men from thinking like men. You can go beyond Christian thought without criminal activity. Christ is black; pick up your pants, dress like a man, clean yourself up. The world says you don't have to. The hell with that, we're teaching you to be proper men. That's curbing crime, debauchery, homosexual lives, and fornication.

We're not telling anybody to pick up weapons or do anything criminal. Don't be a coward condemning the brothers trying to save your people just to appease the enemy and get us back on that leash. We're not doing that.

note.label: Ecclesiastes 12: Remember Now Thy Creator

points: “The words of the wise are as goads”. The words from your leadership prick you into righteousness. A goad is a pointed rod used to urge on an animal. A shepherd prods the sheep with that stick so they don't veer off and get eaten by wolves. Something that urges or stimulates into action; something that pains as if by pricking, a thorn. Those scriptures prick your conscience and the sin in your mind to make you walk straight. To incite or rouse as if with a goad: we're to incite you into righteousness, rouse you up with the word of God. Like the Bible says in Genesis, who shall rouse up that old lion? Judah is like a lion's whelp. The words of God is going to rouse him up. We're going to prick you until you rise up.

We aren't up here to rub your back. A pastor rubbing your back and talking about accessing a portal is rubbing you right on to hell. The preacher is supposed to tell you to get yourself right. We're charged with leading you properly. Sometimes anger stimulates you into righteous action.

“and as nails fastened by the masters of assemblies”. That's Christ coming down through the leadership. We're organizing you, fastening you into a righteous assembly, putting you on the right path and teaching you how to avoid evil. “which are given from one shepherd.” That one shepherd is Christ. That's the shepherd's stick guiding you properly.

Leaders and parents are the goads for the next generation. If we don't provide a righteous path, the next generation will be fractured off and eventually our nation will perish. The Israelite movement is a fractured organization with an objective to destroy the children right under their parents' presence. You might be setting order in the house and the wife might not understand your anger. Tell her to sit down. Don't get in my way. I ain't telling you to tear up nothing, break the windows and all that. When you're trying to establish righteousness in your house, everybody's supposed to understand that.

The mother needs to see the same danger the father sees. Think where these girls could end up if they aren't taught: nine babies, different diseases, no father, a wild bunch of jackasses coming from your daughter. Fight to make them understand because you're afraid for their lives. Righteously snatch their head off, spiritually. When mother and father move the same way, the child grows up right. If the child refuses both, the door is open. Get the hell out and live your life. Our prayer is that you don't go, but if you do, know for certainty you'll be judged.

Mother, father, sister, brother, daughter, son can't come before the commandments. Wicked children will want you to bend the laws for them. I'm not doing that. I did my best; I shake the dust. I'm not going to let my whole body burn trying to save my hand. Make your choice. Like Moses said, choose you this day who you going to follow. All of those that want to follow the commandments, come with me. Same thing that Mattathias said in the Bible. All of those who are standing up for the law of the Lord, you come with me. The rest of y'all burn in hell. That's the attitude you got to have.
